ra: The 72 spirits of the Ars Goetia sit beneath the princely infernal court in the demonological rank structure.
Binsfeld's seven sin-demons are princes of the infernal hierarchy.
Belphegor is a prince of Hell in the early-modern treatises.
Binsfeld 1589: Belphegor presides over SLOTH.
Belphegor tempts with ingenious inventions and the promise of riches; nearest existing abstraction is wealth.
Adramelech is Great Chancellor and council-president of the infernal court (de Plancy).
As council-president/chancellor of Hell, associated with the infernal court's deceptions.
Astaroth is a Grand Duke / Great Prince of the infernal court (Weyer, Michaelis, de Plancy).
Berith (Baalberith) serves as Secretary and Keeper of the Archives of the infernal court (de Plancy).
Lucifer is the chief prince/emperor of Hell in the demonological hierarchies.
Beelzebub is a chief prince of Hell in Weyer and de Plancy.
Leviathan ranks among the princes of Hell (Michaelis, Binsfeld).
Satan is a chief prince/adversary of the infernal hierarchy.
Belial is a chief prince of Hell in Weyer's Pseudomonarchia.
Asmodeus is a king/prince of the infernal court.
Mammon ranks among the princely officers of Hell (Binsfeld, Milton).
Binsfeld 1589: Lucifer presides over PRIDE.
Binsfeld 1589: Mammon presides over GREED.
Binsfeld 1589: Asmodeus presides over LUST.
Binsfeld 1589: Leviathan presides over ENVY.
Binsfeld 1589: Beelzebub presides over GLUTTONY.
Binsfeld 1589: Satan presides over WRATH.
Bael is the 1st of the 72 spirits.
Bael's chief office is invisibility and concealment.
Bael is the demonized form of the Canaanite storm-god Baal.
Agares is the 2nd of the 72 spirits.
Agares teaches all languages and tongues.
Agares causes earthquakes.
Vassago is the 3rd of the 72 spirits.
Vassago declares things past and to come.
Vassago discovers things hidden or lost.
Samigina is the 4th of the 72 spirits.
Samigina teaches all the liberal sciences.
Samigina gives account of the souls of those who died in sin.
Marbas is the 5th of the 72 spirits.
Marbas both causes and cures diseases.
Marbas teaches mechanical arts and handicrafts.
Valefor is the 6th of the 72 spirits.
Valefor tempts his servants to thievery and is a treacherous familiar.
Amon is the 7th of the 72 spirits.
Amon tells of all things past and to come.
Amon procures love and reconciles controversies.
Barbatos is the 8th of the 72 spirits.
Barbatos discovers treasures hidden by enchantments.
Barbatos tells of things past and to come.
Paimon is the 9th of the 72 spirits.
Paimon teaches all arts, sciences and secret things.
Paimon teaches all the arts and sciences.
Buer is the 10th of the 72 spirits.
Buer teaches philosophy, logic and ethics.
Buer teaches the virtues of herbs and heals all distempers.
Gusion is the 11th of the 72 spirits.
Gusion answers things past, present and to come.
Gusion reconciles friends and gives honour and dignity.
Sitri is the 12th of the 72 spirits.
Sitri inflames men and women with love and lust.
Beleth is the 13th of the 72 spirits.
Beleth procures the love of any man or woman.
Leraje is the 14th of the 72 spirits.
Leraje causes battles and putrefies arrow-wounds.
Eligos is the 15th of the 72 spirits.
Eligos knows things to come and of wars.
Eligos discovers hidden things.
Zepar is the 16th of the 72 spirits.
Zepar causes women to love men.
Botis is the 17th of the 72 spirits.
Botis tells of things past and to come.
Botis reconciles friends and foes.
Bathin is the 18th of the 72 spirits.
Bathin knows the secret virtues of herbs and stones.
Sallos is the 19th of the 72 spirits.
Sallos causes men and women to love one another.
Purson is the 20th of the 72 spirits.
Purson tells of things hidden and discovers treasure.
Purson knows things past, present and to come.
Marax is the 21st of the 72 spirits.
Marax teaches astronomy and the liberal sciences.
Marax teaches the virtues of herbs and stones.
Ipos is the 22nd of the 72 spirits.
Ipos knows things past and to come.
Aim is the 23rd of the 72 spirits.
Aim sets cities, castles and great places on fire.
Aim answers truly of private and secret matters.
Naberius is the 24th of the 72 spirits.
Naberius makes men cunning in all arts, especially rhetoric.
Glasya-Labolas is the 25th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches all arts and sciences in an instant and grants invisibility.
Is the author and captain of manslaughter and bloodshed.
Causes love between friends and foes.
Bune is the 26th of the 72 spirits.
Changes the place of the dead and gathers them upon their graves.
Makes men rich, wise and eloquent.
Ronove is the 27th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches rhetoric and the knowledge of tongues.
Procures the favour of friends and foes.
Berith is the 28th of the 72 spirits.
Gives true answers of things past, present and future.
Turns all metals into gold and bestows dignities.
Is a notorious liar not to be trusted.
Astaroth is the 29th of the 72 spirits.
Gives true answers of things past, present and future.
Discovers all secrets and discourses on the fall of the spirits.
Astaroth is the demonized, masculinized reception of the Canaanite goddess Astarte/Ashtoreth.
Forneus is the 30th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches rhetoric, languages and the arts.
Causes men to be loved by friends and foes.
Foras is the 31st of the 72 spirits.
Teaches the virtues of herbs and stones, logic and ethics.
Finds lost things and discovers hidden treasures.
Asmoday is the 32nd of the 72 spirits.
Teaches arithmetic, astronomy, geometry and all handicrafts.
Guards hidden treasure and gives the ring of virtues.
Asmoday is the Goetic reception of Asmodeus (Book of Tobit), ultimately the Avestan Aeshma Daeva.
Gaap is the 33rd of the 72 spirits.
Teaches philosophy and the liberal sciences.
Causes love or hatred at will.
Teaches the consecration of the books of Amaymon and delivers familiars.
Furfur is the 34th of the 72 spirits.
Causes love between man and wife.
Gives true answers of secret and divine things when bound in a triangle.
Marchosias is the 35th of the 72 spirits.
Is a strong and good fighter in battle.
Stolas is the 36th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches astronomy and the virtues of herbs and precious stones.
Phenex is the 37th of the 72 spirits.
Is an excellent poet and gives true answers of the sciences.
Halphas is the 38th of the 72 spirits.
Builds towers full of weapons and sends men of war to appointed places.
Malphas is the 39th of the 72 spirits.
Builds houses and high towers.
Throws down the edifices of enemies and reveals their thoughts.
Deceives those who offer sacrifices to him.
Raum is the 40th of the 72 spirits.
Steals treasure out of kings' houses.
Destroys cities and the dignities of men.
Tells things past, present and future.
Focalor is the 41st of the 72 spirits.
Slays men, drowns them and overthrows ships of war.
Vepar is the 42nd of the 72 spirits.
Causes death by putrefying wounds and breeding worms.
Kills men within three days by wounds that putrefy.
Sabnock is the 43rd of the 72 spirits.
Builds towers, castles and cities furnished with weapons.
Afflicts men with wounds and rotten sores full of worms.
Shax is the 44th of the 72 spirits.
Takes away the sight, hearing and understanding of any man.
Steals money from kings' houses.
Is a deceiver and liar unless commanded into a triangle.
Vine is the 45th of the 72 spirits.
Discovers witches, wizards and hidden things.
Tells things past, present and future.
Builds towers and throws down walls.
Bifrons is the 46th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches astrology, geometry and the virtues of herbs and stones.
Moves corpses from grave to grave and lights candles upon graves.
Vual is the 47th of the 72 spirits.
Procures the love of women and friendship between friends and foes.
Tells things past, present and future.
Haagenti is the 48th of the 72 spirits.
Makes men wise and instructs them in all matters.
Transmutes all metals into gold.
Crocell is the 49th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches geometry and the liberal sciences and discourses of hidden things.
Furcas is the 50th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches philosophy, astronomy, rhetoric, logic, chiromancy and pyromancy.
Balam is the 51st of the 72 spirits.
Answers truly of things past, present and to come.
Alloces is the 52nd of the 72 spirits.
Teaches astronomy and the liberal sciences.
Caim is the 53rd of the 72 spirits.
Gives understanding of the voices of birds and beasts and answers of things to come.
Murmur is the 54th of the 72 spirits.
Constrains the souls of the deceased to appear and answer questions.
Orobas is the 55th of the 72 spirits.
Answers truly of things past, present and to come and of the creation.
Is faithful and does not suffer the conjurer to be tempted by any spirit.
Gremory is the 56th of the 72 spirits.
Procures the love of women, young and old.
Tells of and reveals hidden treasures.
Ose is the 57th of the 72 spirits.
Makes one cunning in the liberal sciences and gives true answers of secret things.
Amy is the 58th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches astrology and the liberal sciences and reveals treasures kept by spirits.
Orias is the 59th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches the virtues of the stars and the mansions of the planets.
Vapula is the 60th of the 72 spirits.
Makes men knowing in handicrafts, professions, philosophy and sciences.
Zagan is the 61st of the 72 spirits.
Transmutes liquids and metals and makes fools wise.
Volac is the 62nd of the 72 spirits.
Gives true answers of hidden treasures and reveals where serpents may be found.
Andras is the 63rd of the 72 spirits.
Sows discord and slays the careless conjurer and his household.
Will kill the master and all his assistants if not warily approached.
Haures (Flauros) is the 64th of the 72 spirits.
Answers truly of divinity, the creation and the fall of spirits.
Destroys the conjurer's enemies by fire and guards him against other spirits.
Andrealphus is the 65th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches geometry, measurement and astronomy and makes men subtle in reasoning.
Cimejes (Kimaris) is the 66th of the 72 spirits.
Teaches grammar, logic and rhetoric and discovers lost or hidden things.
Discovers things lost or hidden and buried treasure.
Amdusias is the 67th of the 72 spirits.
Commands music and bends trees at will.
Belial is the 68th of the 72 spirits.
Gives the favour of friends and foes and distributes preferments and dignities.
The Goetic King Belial is a grimoire-era reception of the biblical/Second-Temple figure Belial.
Decarabia is the 69th of the 72 spirits.
Discovers the virtues of birds and precious stones.
Seere is the 70th of the 72 spirits.
Brings abundance, discovers thefts and hidden treasure.
Dantalion is the 71st of the 72 spirits.
Causes love and shows the likeness of any person anywhere.
Teaches all arts and sciences and reads and changes thoughts.
Andromalius is the 72nd and last of the spirits.
Recovers stolen goods, punishes thieves and exposes hidden wickedness.
Discovers hidden treasures and brings back stolen goods.
